# FAQ-002 Engineering FAQ #2

Revision: Rev A

Q: What lubricant should be ordered for Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01)?
A: The lubricant part number for Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01) is CFW-LUB-709. Refer to maintenance procurement guidance in QS-PROC-10 for ordering flow and approval.

Q: What is the specified torque for the blast wheel liner bolts on Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01)?
A: The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Machining shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L3-SB01) is 105 N·m. Use the bolting procedure in SOP-P1-L3-04 when applying and verifying torque.

Q: Which lubricant is specified for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03)?
A: The lubricant part number for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is CFW-LUB-725. See QS-PROC-10 for stock rotation and SOP-P2-L3-05 for handling and storage requirements.

Q: How long should the spindle warm-up sequence run for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03)?
A: The spindle warm-up time for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 27 minutes. Follow the CNC warm-up checklist in SOP-P1-L3-04 to confirm axis behavior and spindle temperature ramp profile.

Q: What austenitizing setpoint is used for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02)?
A: The austenitizing setpoint for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02) is 845 °C. Validate setpoint and recorder configuration per SOP-P2-L3-05 and document run parameters in QS-PROC-10.

Related documents: QS-PROC-10, SOP-P1-L3-04, SOP-P2-L3-05
